key.description: Stable original source or situation plus the useful outcome. Reuse the key for the same work; source:N is local to this assignment and is not a durable key.

prepared_work.description: Complete useful work, including the claims each source supports, relevant dates, what was checked, remaining uncertainty and any remaining choice.

items.description: A supplied source:N label or an original URL, file path or record identifier you read.

evidence.description: Source references only. Explain claims, dates, checks and uncertainty in the prepared work.

action.description: The exact action to propose after the remaining choice or permission is resolved. Omit when no action is offered.

useful_until.description: Last useful delivery time when the evidence establishes an exact instant. Omit or use null when unknown or inapplicable.
